title: Asmodensius-Native: Freestanding C23, AVX-VNNI, and Pure-Integer PTX Artificial-Life Engine with Multi-Kernel Lean 4.35.0 Model Invariants
description: Windows-native freestanding C23 artificial-life simulation engine (22 core modules, 4 NASM AVX2/AVX-VNNI twins, 41,817 B pure-integer CUDA PTX backend, exact integer matter/energy conservation, 77/77 CTest, 164/164 GPU differential checks) with a 38-declaration Pure Lean 4.35.0 model suite (26 substantive model, boundary, witness, and false-variant refutation theorems including the implemented core/az_chem.c a/4 spread budget, plus 12 explicitly labeled sanity checks) checked locally by 6 checkers and in Ubuntu CI by lean4lean and bubblewrap comparator, plus an AMS-LaTeX white paper and interactive strict-CSP proof blueprint. C23/NASM/PTX code is not verified in Lean. Independent research preprint; not peer-reviewed; 0/1,900 Mega-Atlas open problems retired.
notes: Dual-licensed: Apache-2.0 for code, Lean 4 proofs, and scripts; CC-BY-4.0 for white paper, figures, documentation, and datasets. Software Heritage snapshot: swh:1:snp:08a957772115194b51a4eadb77331b8bab261773. AI coding assistants assisted with implementation iterations, Lean refactoring, and documentation under human review and automated kernel/CTest verification.
